title: Spike: evaluate admin authentication options (token vs mTLS vs Unix socket)
description:
Evaluate three authentication options for the admin HTTP endpoint: (1) static bearer token in config, (2) mutual TLS client certificate, (3) Unix domain socket (localhost-only, no network exposure). Assess: ease of operator configuration, security properties, tooling compatibility (curl, Prometheus scraper). Artifact: docs/admin_auth_options.md with recommendation.

Acceptance: all three options evaluated with pros/cons; recommendation includes rationale; no production code written
